title: Examining the Causal Effect of First Names on Language Models: The Case of Social Commonsense Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the causal effect of substituting highly frequent first names with less frequent first names (based on U.S. Census data) on a model's commonsense reasoning predictions using causal graphs and do-interventions.
Measuring the direct and indirect causal effects on model predictions when substituting male versus female first names and their corresponding pronouns in social commonsense reasoning templates.
